game: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - The Definitive Edition
platform: Nintendo Switch 2 (backward-compat of Switch version; no native edition found)

findings.name: Respect
findings.detail: Raised by missions and gang territory wins; caps number of recruitable homies (up to 7). Maxing it grants the 'Original Gangster' achievement/trophy.
findings.trackable: Stats menu (progress bar per stat, per one weaker source). Max-respect trophy is listed as 'Original Gangster'.

findings.name: Sex Appeal
findings.detail: Raised by clothes, haircuts, tattoos, and the car CJ arrives in (lowriders/sports cars best). Collecting all 50 Oysters maxes it. 'Chick Magnet' = max sex appeal. One source says 100% muscle hurts sex appeal; another says muscle/fat do not affect it (sources conflict).

findings.name: Fat
findings.detail: Raised by eating at fast food (approx light 0, low ~1%, medium ~2%, high ~3.5%); lowered by running/gym machines. 'I'll Have Two Number 9s' = reach max fat via large meals.

findings.name: Muscle
findings.detail: Gyms and running/swimming/cycling. Needs >=35% for gym trainers to fight you. Each gym teaches 3 fighting moves. 'Get a Pump' = one barbell curl or bench press at any gym. Muscle burns off if fat is zero and CJ stops eating.
findings.trackable: Stats screen; gym moves learned are NOT shown in stats menu (per a PowerPyx comment).

findings.name: Stamina and Lung Capacity
findings.detail: Stamina by swimming/running/cycling/gym; lung capacity by underwater swimming. Collecting all 50 Oysters maxes lung capacity. Burglar side mission giving infinite stamina is single-source claim.

findings.name: Weapon skills
findings.detail: 'Swiss Army Strife' requires maxing all 10 eligible weapon skills to Hitman (PowerPyx); gtabase says 'all weapon skills'. Each Ammu-Nation shooting challenge gives 200 skill in its weapon.

findings.name: Vehicle skills (driving, bike, cycling, flying, boat) and schools
findings.detail: Cycling skill >20% for BMX challenge (60%+ recommended, 'Bike or Biker'), >40% for Chiliad Challenge. Driving skill >=20% for 8-Track. 100% requires bronze in Driving School (12 lessons), Boat School (5), Bike School (6), Flying School (10; bronze done during 'Learning to Fly').
findings.trackable: Stats screen for skill percentages; school medals appear in school menus.

findings.name: Collectibles (required for 100%)
findings.detail: 100 Gang Tags (Los Santos), 50 Snapshots (San Fierro), 50 Horseshoes (Las Venturas), 50 Oysters (underwater). Rewards: tags unlock weapons at Johnson House; snapshots weapons at Doherty Garage + $100,000; horseshoes weapons at Four Dragons Casino + $100,000; oysters $100,000 + max lung + girlfriends date regardless of appearance. Note: 70 Unique Jumps are NOT required for 100%.
findings.trackable: Stats screen collectible counters (assumed from original; DE-specific display not confirmed).

findings.name: 100% completion ('Remastered')
findings.detail: Requires 98 Story Missions and 26 Asset Missions plus other items. Reward: $1,000,000, full ammo, Hydra at Sweet's house, Rhino under Grove Street bridge, and the 'Remastered' trophy. Users report getting stuck at 99.47% (unbought Palomino Creek property, unfinished Chiliad Challenge race, Blood Bowl, Millie heist) - unverified.
findings.trackable: Stats menu shows completion percentage (implied by user reports of 99.47%).

findings.name: Who Needs Directions? (Mike Toreno mission)
findings.detail: Drive to Easter Basin Airport in San Fierro ignoring hints. Missable per PowerPyx. Missions cannot be replayed (GamerGuides).

findings.name: They Can't Stop All of Us (Black Project mission)
findings.detail: Infiltrate underground base without triggering the above-ground alarm; pops after mission end. Missable.

findings.name: Assassin (Madd Dogg's Rhymes mission)
findings.detail: Stealth-kill every guard in the mansion section unseen; pops on leaving mansion. Missable.

findings.name: Gang territories lost after leaving Los Santos
findings.detail: All held turfs are lost when first leaving Los Santos; after 'Home Coming' they must be recaptured. 53 turfs total. 'Ain't Nothing But a G Thing' requires all turfs, all properties, and $1,000,000. Capturing turfs early is wasted effort. Turfs are NOT required for 100% completion.
findings.trackable: Map shows turf ownership; exact turf counter unconfirmed.

findings.name: Girlfriends / 'Not a Player'
findings.detail: 6 potential girlfriends per PowerPyx. Trophy pops when the 6th date starts. Dating Katie Zhan lets you keep weapons on death. Girlfriend relationships to 100% not required for 100% completion.
findings.trackable: Girlfriend percentages in Stats screen (original game feature; DE not confirmed).

findings.name: Gambling achievements
findings.detail: Lucky Spinner: win $1,000+ on one Wheel of Fortune spin (max bet $10). What are the Odds: win one Inside Track race (save before betting). Double or Nothin': bet table max on red/black at roulette until win. All save-scumming friendly.
findings.trackable: Gambling skill listed in stats (gtaintel); no per-bet counter confirmed.

findings.name: Today Was a Good Day
findings.detail: Go 24 in-game hours without breaking the law, being wanted, or harming anyone.

findings.name: 48 achievements (full list)
findings.detail: Per gta.wiki: Getting Started, With Extra Dip, The End of the Line, Hoopin' it Up, A Legitimate Business, I'll Have Two Number 9s, The American Dream, Pay 'n' Spray, Bike or Biker, Who Needs Directions?, Liberty City State of Mind, Swiss Army Strife, School's Out, Horror of the Santa Maria, They Can't Stop All of Us, Smooth Moves, What the City Needs, Savior, Rescue a Kitten Too?, Yes I Speak English, Lucky Spinner, What happens in Las Venturas..., All Dressed Up for San Fierro, Not a Player, What are the Odds, Double or Nothin', Assassin, Original Gangster, Today Was a Good Day, Public Enemy No. 1, Chick Magnet, Ain't Nothing But a G Thing, Remastered, ...Here we go again, I Ain't No Buster, Sticky Fingers, 81 Years Too Late, Get a Pump, Beat the Cock, Metrosexual, Where'd He Go?, High As a Kite, Represent, Assert Yourself Next Time, Serial Offender, Freight Date, Time to Kill, Lots of Guns. Split across platforms: 35 PlayStation trophies (1 Plat/5 Gold/8 Silver/21 Bronze), 34 Xbox achievements, 13 extra Rockstar Social Club accomplishments (PC) = 48 total.

Stats menu (implied by PowerPyx user reports of being stuck at 99.47%)

versionNotes.note: No native Nintendo Switch achievement system exists, and no source found says the Switch version has any achievements/trophies/Social Club accomplishments. Rockstar's 2021 release said updated Achievements/Trophies exist for the trilogy and that PC gets additional Social Club accomplishments; Switch version feature list names only gyro aiming and touch screen. Treat Switch having ZERO in-game achievements as likely but UNCONFIRMED.

No Switch 2 Edition of the GTA Trilogy found as of Oct 2026. Switch 2 runs the original Switch release via backward compatibility (Sportskeeda: Rockstar titles incl. the Trilogy work; claims steadier 30fps, faster loading, 720p - single secondary source). Red Dead Redemption got a dedicated Switch 2 version in Dec 2025 but not the Trilogy. Nintendo's own eShop page lists no Switch 2 Edition.

Switch-specific: gyro aiming and touch screen camera/menu support. Launch Switch version had very poor performance (VGC 2/5, ~20fps dips); Nintendo Life later checked patch improvements (conclusion not read).
Local 2-player co-op from the original console versions was removed in the DE (Den of Geek, Cheat Code Central, Sportskeeda).

Songs cut from DE radio: counts disagree - 17 (Nintendo Wire/GTAIntel) vs 21 (Sportskeeda). Cuts largely predate the DE (rights lapsed in earlier releases). Cut music reportedly remained on disk in PC files (unverified).

Interiors: original reportedly 150+ hidden interiors vs ~33 in DE (single source, GTAIntel, suspect). Some cheats dropped. Some haircut options missing. Analog steering removed, fewer civilians/vehicles. Weapons are kept after death. Mid-mission checkpoint restart added.
PowerPyx recommends Performance mode over Fidelity because some cutscenes may crash in Fidelity (PS-focused; Switch has no such modes presumably).

gaps: Could NOT confirm whether the Switch version has any in-game achievements, or whether Social Club accomplishments sync on Switch. Needs an authoritative source (Rockstar Support / Switch player reports).
Could NOT confirm if a native Switch 2 Edition exists; none found (searched up to Oct 2026). Compat claims are from secondary sources.
Did not obtain the exact layout of the DE Stats menu (which stats shown, counters for tags/snapshots/horseshoes/oysters, turfs owned, girlfriend percentages). Original SA shows these; DE unverified.
Girlfriend count: PowerPyx says 6 dates for the trophy; original game has 6 (Denise, Michelle, Helena, Barbara, Katie, Millie). Names not confirmed here.
Max values for each stat (e.g. exact respect/sex appeal thresholds) and decay rules not confirmed.
Whether gambling skill is displayed in the DE Stats menu not confirmed.
Count of missable story missions beyond the 3 trophy ones, and other lost content after story points (besides turfs) not researched in depth.
Gta.fandom and GamerGuides/PushSquare pages returned errors, so no wiki cross-check of stats.
